content.short: TON Bulk Sender is a CoinTool utility for batch transfers of TON and jettons to large wallet lists in one workflow.
content.description: TON Bulk Sender is a CoinTool transfer utility designed for teams that need to distribute TON or jettons to many recipients from one dashboard. The app is built around bulk sending tasks such as uploading wallet lists, assigning token amounts, reviewing totals, and submitting a single multisend flow instead of preparing transfers one by one. It fits airdrops, community rewards, payroll style distributions, and operational payments for projects that manage recurring token payouts on TON at larger scale.
content.meta: TON Bulk Sender helps teams distribute TON and jettons in bulk with address uploads, amount reviews, and one session multisend execution.
